d: Long, wavy jet black hair flows down the back with short, blunt bangs. Large, wide-set olive green eyes sit on a youthful face of a child. The build is slender and small, dressed in a cropped white long-sleeved top over a terracotta-colored bra, paired with a green draped skirt layered under a black patterned hip scarf featuring silver coin embellishments and orange ruffles. Signature details include a gold headband, gold hoop earrings, a silver necklace, a gold anklet shaped like a coiled snake, and a small brown snake perched on one finger.
